text:
Nate (CSM): Quick check-in on the HeronBank private/VPC onboarding — need status for exec health report. Renewal conversation next week, want to flag any blockers.
Marie (CS Ops): Quick summary: networking mostly done, IAM/KMS outstanding, audit logs pending confirmation. Will list blockers below.
AJ (NetOps): VPC created and peered. VPC ID vpc-0f3b9a12. Route table entries pushed for subnets. Waiting on customer to approve NAT gateway costs.
Ben (Infra): KMS key policy draft is in the shared doc: https://redwood.app/keys/heronbank-kms-draft — need cross-account principal from their security team. I left a suggested key alias: alias/redwood/heronbank-prod.
Marie (CS Ops): IAM: we need their AWS account ID and the exact role name they want for cross-account assume. I pinged their security lead yesterday, no reply yet.
Claire (Enablement): I have the runbook ready for handoff and a 30m enablement demo. Can do Wed or Thu. Will include steps: endpoint validation, audit log verification, and failover test.
Nate (CSM): Customer mentioned audit log retention policy — they want 7 years. Are we good to recommend managed S3 lifecycle + Glacier?
Ben (Infra): Yes — suggest lifecycle: 90d -> GLACIER_IR, 365d -> DEEP_ARCHIVE for compliance. Also enable S3 MFA delete in the bucket policy. I'll template the CloudTrail config:```json
{
  "Trail": "heronbank-trail",
  "S3BucketName": "rb-heronbank-audit",
  "IncludeGlobalServiceEvents": true,
  "IsMultiRegionTrail": true
}
```
AJ (NetOps): Security groups: we locked inbound to Redwood egress CIDRs and customer subnets. Recommend customer open 443 from their app tier only. Sample SG rule: `Type: HTTPS, Port: 443, Source: 10.10.0.0/24`
Marie (CS Ops): Blockers list for exec health: 1) customer security lead hasn't approved KMS cross-account principal, 2) NAT gateway cost approval, 3) scheduled enablement slot not confirmed. These map to renewal risk if not cleared by next week.
Nate (CSM): Can we mitigate risk with a temporary fallback (hosted proxy) while KMS approval lands? Customer agreed to temporary key provisioning?
Ben (Infra): We can spin a host-provided encryption key in their VPC (customer-managed CMK in their account) as fallback, but proper cross-account KMS is preferred. I'll draft fallback steps.
Claire (Enablement): I'll offer two enablement options in the invite: "full cutover" and "staged with fallback". That should reduce friction.
Marie (CS Ops): Capture feedback: customer worried about latency over peering route. They asked if we can run an e2e latency test during the enablement window.
AJ (NetOps): We can run a quick iperf from their app subnet to the inference endpoint and share p50/p95 stats. I'll prepare the command.
deploy-bot: Network config change applied to heronbank-prod: route table rtb-07d3 updated (change id cfg-8891).
Nate (CSM): Action items/owners: AJ -> iperf test + NAT cost delta (ETA EOD), Ben -> finalize KMS policy + fallback doc (ETA tomorrow morning), Claire -> send invite with 2 slots (ETA EOD), Marie -> follow up with customer security lead and update health doc (ETA EOD).
Marie (CS Ops): Noted. I'll also add a short note in the renewal tracker: "Onboarding delayed due to security approvals — monitor daily".
Nate (CSM): Thanks. If we clear KMS + enablement by Thu, I'll mark health as "at risk -> monitoring". If not, escalate to AMs.
Claire (Enablement): I'll include the audit verification checklist in the invite and the post-runbook notes.
Ben (Infra): One more: KMS key rotation policy — customer requires 90d rotation. Our default is 365. I'll flag this as a config decision to confirm.
Marie (CS Ops): Good catch. I'll add rotation cadence to the pre-meeting checklist.
Nate (CSM): OK all — please update the thread when items are done. I'll prepare the renewal note for leadership with current mitigations. :thumbsup:
AJ (NetOps): Will update after iperf.
Ben (Infra): KMS policy draft updated, pushed link in the doc.
Claire (Enablement): Invites sent for Wed 10:30 and Thu 15:00 UTC.
Marie (CS Ops): Follow-up: customer security lead responded — provided account ID 123456789012 and prefers role name `HeronBankRedwoodAssumeRole`. Laddering into Ben for KMS principal.
Nate (CSM): Great progress. Last message before I close the health loop: please post final confirmation of audit logs writing to bucket and sample p95 latency.
Marie (CS Ops): Will do — closing loop by EOD tomorrow.
